score_objections.objection: Evidence for 'Leans national rule' is thin: asked directly whether he would back a bill preempting state AI regulation, Yakym did not endorse preemption (the tracker's own item 9 concedes this); the only support is the reporter's 'sounded willing to consider' gloss and a super PAC listing him as a champion.
